tools.name: convert_markdown
tools.description: Convert the complete supplied Markdown into PDF, DOCX, HTML or EPUB anonymously. No URL fetch, project access, account or OAuth grant. Limits: 128 KiB UTF-8 Markdown, 512 KiB request, 2 MiB file. Returns an embedded base64 file, not a hosted download. Existing renderer formatting/image limits apply;
